route_title: Visible-Centered Stack for Maximum Passband Transmission
compilation_rationale: Compiled a 36-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica with explicit alternating layers, uniform 20–350 nm optimization bounds, and three band-specific transmittance constraints. Physics defaults to coherent planar TMM at normal incidence. Uncertainty uses absolute normal noise as no relative tolerance was specified.
